race.comment: Open edition of the Sandown Guineas, last year won by Sheza Alibi. Not sure any of these will quite reach her heights but HARRY LIME (4) looks a good each-way bet. He was effectively first up in the Listed Amanda Elliott at Flemington and stuck on well for third. Tipping he'll come on plenty from that and he maps for a lovely run. Liked the maiden win of ANGLAIS (12) last start at Ballarat, bolting in by four lengths. She's an ex-Nick Ryan horse now with Clinton McDonald but fancy she can measure up. STRONG TEMPO (6) got back in a very slowly run G3 Carbine Club at Flemington last time but hit the line well. Probably gets a fair way back again but can figure. MILSONS POINT (1) was just behind HARRY LIME at Flemington and meets him much better off at the weights but he's been up a while. MAGNA SENTENTIA (7) bolted in with a Geelong maiden last time over 1318m in solid time, turns around quickly here and drawn wide but he's clearly talented.
